description: Verify that from SYN-SENT, DUT acknowledges tester ISN by emitting ACK with ack_num == tester_seq + 1 (RFC 793 §3.4)
approach:
[Objective]
Mirror of SEQUENCE_01 for active OPEN: DUT in SYN-SENT receives SYN,ACK from tester → DUT third-leg ACK has ack_num = tester_seq + 1.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT active OPEN → SYN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN,ACK with seq=I.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: ACK with ack_num == I+1.

[Pass condition]
DUT ACK ack_num == tester seq + 1.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_ack_num — ack_num mismatch
• Fail_timeout — no DUT ACK

verdicts.Pass: DUT third-leg ACK ack_num = ISN+1 — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_ack_num: DUT ack_num does not acknowledge tester ISN
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT ACK to SYN,ACK within listen window
